query:
One group member made a point of requesting that the exact trip dates be confirmed before the end of the week, expressing a need to check their calendar before fully committing. Which member made this specific request?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Dev
C. Simone
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T17:54:00) In, assuming I can confirm by end of week. Just to flag, I'd need the exact dates locked down so I can check my calendar properly. Can we confirm Friday at the latest?
[2] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:42:00) Three weeks. I told Priya the same day I signed but I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here. It felt wrong to tell the group before I'd made it official.
[3] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-10-26T18:11:00) ok right trip logistics because I genuinely need to sort the train. Marcus did you book the bunkhouse? like actually book it or 'I'll do it Monday' book it
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:01:00) so the plan is Priya stands at the bottom in enormous waterproofs while Dev and Marcus sprint past her like it's a race 😑 amazing. Simone you're the only reasonable person coming on this trip
[5] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:48:00) December 19th. I fly January 6th. So there's time to do something properly before I go. I'd like that, if everyone's up for it. Something quiet. Not a party, just us.
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:26:00) Good. Wednesday works better for news. You should know by the weekend and we can celebrate at trivia if it goes well, or I'll write a consolation round if not. Either way, the infrastructure is there.
[7] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:22:00) I'm in for the 7th if it doesn't clash with the thing. the 13th for trivia I'll confirm this week
[8] (about=Priya, episodic, t0 @2025-10-05T18:41:00) I'm in if it doesn't clash with the thing. Friday should be ok but I'll confirm Weds 👍
[9] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2025-11-16T20:14:00) Checkout.
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:31:00) You're welcome to join us, Jonah. Dev and I are doing a twelve-kilometre trail route on the 30th. No Priya, obviously. She's been formally excused on medical grounds.
[11] (about=Jonah, episodic, t4 @2025-10-19T19:26:00) ok hold on, slight tangent, what is everyone's worst date story because I'm realising I've been sitting on a very good one from Berlin and you all deserve to hear it
[12] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:38:00) A city trip is a reasonable counterproposal. We can vote in January. For now the Kinder Scout faction wins on points. Anyway. Simone, I wanted to check in. You were a bit quiet on the train back. You alright?
[13] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:32:00) medical grounds is a polite way to say I just don't want to 😌 you three go, I'll have a nice Sunday. maybe I'll do a bit of scouting for that city trip I'm planning
